record.paper_title: Open Problems in the Topology of Manifolds
record.original_question: For q >= 2, work with connected compact smooth 2q-manifolds. For a natural number g, let W_g be the connected sum of g copies of S^q x S^q. Two compact smooth 2q-manifolds M0 and M1 with the same Euler characteristic are stably diffeomorphic if M0 # W_g is diffeomorphic to M1 # W_g for some g >= 0. The stable class S_st(M) consists of diffeomorphism classes of 2q-manifolds with the same Euler characteristic as M that are stably diffeomorphic to M, and cancellation holds for M when this stable class has exactly one element. The genus g(M) is the largest g such that M is diffeomorphic to M0 # W_g for some compact smooth 2q-manifold M0. For a finitely presented group pi and epsilon in {+1,-1}, define the epsilon-cancellation genus cg_epsilon(pi) to be the minimum genus bound g0 such that cancellation holds for every 2q-manifold M with epsilon = (-1)^q, pi1(M) is isomorphic to pi, and g(M) >= g0, if such a bound exists, and infinity otherwise. Is there a finitely presented group pi that is not polycyclic-by-finite and nevertheless has cg_epsilon(pi) < infinity for some epsilon?

evidence.quote: For a natural number g, define Wg := #g(Sq x Sq) to be the g-fold connected sum of Sq x Sq with itself.
Problem A. (Genus bounds for general groups) Is there an example of a finitely presented group pi which is not polycyclic-by-finite and for which cg_epsilon(pi) < infinity for some epsilon?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Fix an integer q ≥ 2. All manifolds below are connected compact smooth 2q-manifolds. For a nonnegative integer g, let W_g denote the g-fold connected sum of S^q × S^q with itself (with W_0 the 2q-sphere). Two such manifolds M_0 and M_1 with χ(M_0) = χ(M_1) are called stably diffeomorphic if M_0 # W_g is diffeomorphic to M_1 # W_g for some g ≥ 0. Given M, its stable class S_st(M) is the set of diffeomorphism classes of compact smooth 2q-manifolds N with χ(N) = χ(M) that are stably diffeomorphic to M. We say cancellation holds for M when |S_st(M)| = 1. The genus g(M) is the largest integer g ≥ 0 such that M is diffeomorphic to M_0 # W_g for some compact smooth 2q-manifold M_0.

For a finitely presented group π and ε ∈ {+1, −1}, define the ε-cancellation genus cg_ε(π) to be the smallest integer g_0 ≥ 0 such that cancellation holds for every compact smooth 2q-manifold M satisfying ε = (−1)^q, π_1(M) ≅ π, and g(M) ≥ g_0; if no such g_0 exists, set cg_ε(π) = ∞.

Question: Does there exist a finitely presented group π which is not polycyclic-by-finite, such that cg_ε(π) < ∞ for some ε ∈ {+1, −1}?
artifact.status_search_result: Known cancellation results in the stable diffeomorphism classification of 2q-manifolds (Crowley–Sixt and others) establish finiteness of the cancellation genus for polycyclic-by-finite fundamental groups, but no example beyond that class appears in the literature. The question is posed as an open problem in recent surveys on open problems in the topology of manifolds, and no resolution was located.

status_evidence.snippet: Cancellation results for stably diffeomorphic manifolds with polycyclic-by-finite fundamental group.
status_evidence.claim: Existing cancellation finiteness results require polycyclic-by-finite fundamental group.
